$comment: Rhetorical functions an exemplar can be tagged with, per section. Used by find_exemplars.py and evolve.py add-exemplars.

abstract.gap: what fails or is missing, when, and why
abstract.insight: the observation the method follows from
abstract.method: the method named with its category and its one idea
abstract.stance: what the work changes for the field

intro.scene: a concrete case the reader can picture
intro.task: the task in operational terms and why it matters
intro.credit: specific achievements of prior work, before criticizing it
intro.gap: the observable limitation and the condition under which it appears
intro.reason: the technical cause of the gap ('The main reason is ...')
intro.tension: two goals that pull apart, or an obvious fix that is too costly
intro.question: the open question the paper asks
intro.insight: the observation about the problem, stated directly
intro.goal: the goal phrased as a mechanism
intro.method: the method and how its parts depend on each other
intro.contrast: the closest work and one checkable difference
intro.evidence: a calibrated result sentence with scope
intro.stance: what the work changes for the field
intro.scope: what the paper does and does not address
intro.transition: a turn between paragraphs without a logical connector

method.opener: input, output and components, pointing to the overview figure
method.need: the problem a component solves, before its mechanism
method.property: why it works / what it guarantees
method.delta: what stays the same as the base method
method.rule-out: the obvious alternative and why it fails

evaluation.opener: what is evaluated, or the questions the experiments answer
evaluation.setup: datasets, metrics, baselines and how they were run
evaluation.claim-first: a result paragraph that opens with the finding
evaluation.mechanism: the result explained by a component and its operation
evaluation.ablation: one ablation answering one design question
evaluation.bounded-claim: a result stated with its scope or exception
evaluation.limitation: a concrete failure mode with its cause

related.contrast: a line of work and how this paper differs
related.closest: the closest work and the checkable difference
related.complementary: work that is orthogonal and could be combined
